name: Altitude limit 500 m via radio port (Lito X1)
description: Route B for the same write as altitude_500_lito_x1.json: g_config.flying_limit.max_height = 500 (hash 8a237103, 0x01F4 U16 LE) sent the way both hardware measurements sent it - on the standard DUML port 40009 as MOBILE_APP index 4 with ACK_BEFORE_EXEC, between the service-mode enter and exit frames of fcc.json (frames 1, 3 and 21 of that profile). doesthings/FreeFCC v1.4.01 (issue #9, Lito X1, 500 m in DJI Fly) and lmdegreeds/dji_fcc_gpsoff (parameter dump 120 -> 500, doc/PROTOCOL.md) both used this port and identity. Timing as fcc.json. Holds the hardware lock while it runs, because the keepalive shares this port.

frames.note: AUTOTEST set: enter service mode (dst=SVO) - frame 1 of fcc.json
FLYCONTROLLER write param by hash: g_config.flying_limit.max_height = 500 (0x01F4 LE) - frame 3 of fcc.json
AUTOTEST exit service mode (dst=SVO) - frame 21 of fcc.json
